forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Primary text, filled CTA buttons, link text, nav borders, card borders — the structural backbone. This near-black green carries 90% of the interface weight

highlighter-yellow.$description: Highlighter Yellow — Text highlight wash (behind keywords in headlines), badge backgrounds, accent fills. Always reads as a marker stroke, never as a CTA

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, nav background — the warm off-white everything sits on. Slightly yellow-shifted to feel like aged paper, not screen white

pencil-gray.$description: Pencil Gray — Nav and divider borders — a single mid-gray for hairlines that should recede

whisper-gray.$description: Whisper Gray — Muted helper text, secondary labels — disappears into the cream canvas

sticky-note-teal.$description: Sticky Note Teal — Teal action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

sticky-note-mint.$description: Sticky Note Mint — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

sticky-note-blush.$description: Sticky Note Blush — Decorative button/card fill. Sprinkle use only

terracotta.$description: Terracotta — Decorative card accent — warm counterpoint to the green/yellow palette

bricolage-grotesque.$description: Display headlines only. Custom variable font with positive tracking (0.04-0.05em) that makes characters feel chunky and sticker-like. This is the signature voice — never use for body or UI.

inter.$description: Everything functional: body copy, nav, buttons, cards, subheadings. Weight 400 for body, 500-600 for labels and subheads, 700 for section headings. Clean humanist sans that lets the Bricolage display type stay loud.

roboto-mono.$description: Micro-labels in nav, small caps-style tags, and technical metadata. Mono signals 'tool/utility' context within the otherwise rounded typographic system.
